operativeScope.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann den Aufbau der DNA aus Nukleotiden modellhaft darstellen und den Zusammenhang zwischen Basenfolge, komplementärer Basenpaarung und Speicherung genetischer Information erklären.
operativeScope.proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can model DNA structure from nucleotides and explain the relationship between base sequence, complementary base pairing and the storage of genetic information.

scientificFindings: Unwound ladder is a schematic two-strand structural representation, not a claim that DNA is physically a flat ladder.
Four complementary pairs are A-T, G-C, C-G, T-A. A-T has two dashed hydrogen-bond links and G-C three.

Strands are antiparallel: left 5-prime at top and 3-prime at bottom, right 3-prime at top and 5-prime at bottom. Free terminal phosphate circles are on the 5-prime ends, terminal OH labels on the 3-prime sugars.

Blue sugar and yellow phosphate form each backbone; bases attach to sugars, not to phosphate. Complete top-right T base/sugar/attached 5-side phosphate is selected together and connected to a complete three-part nucleotide inset.
Sequence, complementary pairing and information-storage caption support revised structure/information atom; there is no unsupported DNA replication or biochemical synthesis performance claim.
responsiveFindings: At 360 pixels, four base pairs, opposing arrows, prime-number ends and the three-component nucleotide inset remain recognizable.

The small terminal OH labels are supplementary fine annotations at phone width; their exact chemistry was inspected natively and at 680. Do not require phone users to decode tiny OH text as the main competence.
At 680 pixels all primary labels, paired bases, backbone and complete selection callout are clear.

goals.altTextRecommendationDe: Schematische DNA-Leiter mit zwei gegenläufigen 5′→3′-Strängen. Den Basen A, G, C und T stehen T, C, G und A gegenüber; A–T ist durch zwei, G–C durch drei Wasserstoffbrücken verbunden. Die 5′-Enden tragen Phosphat, die 3′-Enden eine freie OH-Gruppe am Zucker. Ein vollständiges T-Nukleotid aus Phosphat, Zucker und Base ist markiert und vergrößert. Die Basenfolge speichert genetische Information.

operativeScope.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Trennung von DNA-Fragmenten durch Gelelektrophorese erklären und vorgegebene Bandenmuster mithilfe eines Größenmarkers begründet auswerten.
operativeScope.proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can explain how gel electrophoresis separates DNA fragments and use a size marker to interpret supplied band patterns with reasons.

scientificFindings: All three wells are aligned at the negative/top side; migration arrow points toward positive/bottom side. This is the correct orientation for negatively charged DNA in a standard separation model.

Four marker bands and two bands per sample are separate horizontal bands. Smaller LINEAR fragments travel farther under common gel conditions; the image explicitly limits its rule to linear fragments.
Band height supports comparison with a size marker. No numerical bp values are present, so the image offers qualitative relative size orientation, not exact numerical calibration.
No band position, matching size or band count is portrayed as proof of sequence equality, identity, genotype, disease or PCR performance. No practical experiment is claimed.
responsiveFindings: At 360 pixels lanes, wells, marker/sample labels, four marker bands and two bands per sample are separable; electrode signs and migration direction remain visible.
At 680 pixels the same relationships and linear-fragment qualification are clearly readable.
Large length cues and sparse bands avoid a miniature measurement puzzle.

operativeScope.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann an einem gegebenen eukaryotischen Genmodell erklären, wie Transkriptionsfaktoren über regulatorische DNA-Bereiche die Transkription beeinflussen.
operativeScope.proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can use a supplied eukaryotic gene model to explain how transcription factors influence transcription through regulatory DNA regions.

scientificFindings: A distinct activating protein factor is bound to the labeled regulatory DNA region; RNA polymerase is a separate shape at a separate start region.
Dotted interaction arrow is labeled promotes and represents facilitation, not a covalent DNA link or mRNA strand. A separate process arrow leads to multiple single RNA strands labeled more mRNA.

Activating factor and shown model: activation are visible explicit qualifications. There is no claim that every transcription factor activates, that regulation is always binary on/off, or that basal transcript production is zero.
Regulatory, start and gene regions form a simple abstract eukaryotic gene model. No specific sequence, physical contact mechanism, methylation or protein-product conclusion is invented.
responsiveFindings: At 360 pixels factor/DNA binding, polymerase at the start, regulatory/gene regions and increased mRNA are visually distinct.
Both activating-example qualifications are readable on phone and desktop.
At 680 pixels all major labels and arrow roles are clear; friendly protein shapes remain separate.

operativeScope.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann den prokaryotischen Grundbauplan eines Bakteriums an einem gegebenen Schema darstellen und die Lage seiner Erbinformation einschließlich gegebenenfalls vorhandener Plasmide erläutern.
operativeScope.proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can use a supplied diagram to model the prokaryotic structure of a bacterium and explain the location of its genetic information, including plasmids when present.

scientificFindings: Cell wall is outer orange layer; membrane is the inner green boundary; cytoplasm, ribosomes and chromosomal DNA are inside. Chromosomal DNA is not enclosed by a nucleus or nuclear membrane.
Two small closed plasmid DNA rings are separate from the large coiled chromosome and from ribosome dots. The explicit label says plasmids can occur.
Footer states model with wall and plasmids, no nucleus. This bounds optional features to the shown example instead of asserting every bacterium has a wall or plasmids.
The drawing does not imply all bacteria have one circular chromosome, an exact genome/plasmid copy number or these particular surface appendages. Unlabeled appendages are incidental model features.
No division, conjugation, transformation, vector transfer or genetic-engineering procedure is claimed; the revised atom is cell structure and information location.
responsiveFindings: At 360 pixels large coiled DNA, small plasmid rings, separate wall/membrane and absence of nucleus remain clear; the main DNA-in-cytoplasm and plasmid qualifier are readable.
The parenthetical Bakterienchromosom is a supplementary small annotation on phone; core DNA location is conveyed by the larger label and structure.
At 680 pixels named structures, callout destinations and wall/plasmid model qualification are clear.

goals.altTextRecommendationDe: Schematisches Bakterium mit Zellwand und Zellmembran. Das Bakterienchromosom liegt als große aufgewickelte DNA im Zellplasma ohne Zellkern. Zwei kleinere getrennte DNA-Ringe zeigen mögliche Plasmide; Punkte markieren Ribosomen. Das gezeigte Modell besitzt eine Zellwand und Plasmide, ohne diese Merkmale für jedes Bakterium zu behaupten.
